summary: All eight phases have landed on each target repo's main, and every acceptance criterion V01–V14 has implementing work I checked in the repos: both deploy repos carry the judgment layer, a three-key .architecturerc, a Jenkinsfile.architecture that publishes one stage, and the aac-tools test verbs; P1 adds the aac_tools container template; P5 deletes the fixture and names its successor; P6 adds the HelmCharts pinning test; P7 adds the runbook how-to; P8 records D50 and slice 012's order; P3 corrects the relay comment. None of the eight done-records admits a leftover. No requirement or ruling (R1–R7, D1, D2, Q1, B1, A1, A2) is left undelivered. The remaining close-out items are either out of scope (S1, S2, S4, S7) or a design call (S5), so none clears the bar for a new phase. I fixed one runbook sentence (S8) as residue in Ansible 7c4b8e6 and struck the entry. I also added A3 for the two held pushes and noted the push preconditions on A1 and A2.
